# Cloudflare

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Security dashboards, condition builders, configuration tables, analytics filters and dialogs.

Captured 2026-10-31, Signed-in owner free-plan dashboard; public landing page separately labelled. Themes: light, dark.

Measured Cloudflare dashboard and public marketing reference. The dashboard was captured on 2026-10-31 in Codex's visible in-app browser. The signed-in free account exposed security rules, an unsaved custom-rule editor, security analytics, filters and security settings. Dashboard samples cover dark and light at 1440 × 1000, with settings and configuration dialogs at 390 × 844.

The public marketing site was refreshed on 2026-11-22, signed out, in headless Chromium. Desktop shots are 1440 × 900 at 1x. Phone shots are 390 × 844 CSS pixels at 2x (780 × 1688 PNG pixels). The control map is [site-tree.md](site-tree.md). Login and signup were photographed empty and not filled. The dashboard was not entered on this pass.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Dashboard computed styles name Inter Variable with system sans fallbacks; legacy controls also use the system font stack. `core.font.mono` records Paper Mono's declared stack. Public readings name the site's own families where present. Font binaries are not included or licensed by this extraction. Use a licensed local font or the recorded fallback stack; previews may use fallbacks.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

This is sampled coverage, not full component or theme parity. Raw declarations include legacy Cloudflare and Kumo colors; a declared primitive does not prove it was used on that page. Component tokens use actual computed CSS, while named role tokens retain their declared CSS variable evidence. Functional colors remain in their measured syntax. The public hero and its decorative demonstrations do not prove signed-in dashboard behavior.

The public full-page attempt had blank scroll-triggered sections and was rejected outside Git. Viewport screenshots intentionally show portions of longer pages, not an entire document. The field dropdown is an internally scrolling list; the crop shows only its visible options. Appearance-menu imagery proves the visible user menu, not an open appearance submenu. Rejected intermediate mobile animation frames are not retained.

The 18 `dark.preview.*`, `light.preview.*` and `marketing.preview.*` colors are Derived 8-bit sRGB previews of the original measured semantic roles. Their sources identify the original token, conversion, rounding and any gamut clipping. Original measured values remain unchanged. No token is Sampled or Reconstruction. The style guide's layout is an illustrative presentation, not a reconstruction of an unobserved Cloudflare screen. Not captured values include a complete spacing scale, all elevation levels, reduced-motion behavior, every breakpoint, icon geometry and complete state palettes.

The identification icon came from [Cloudflare dashboard apple-touch icon](https://dash.cloudflare.com/apple-touch-icon-144x144.png), resized from 144 × 144 to 128 × 128. It is private catalogue identification material, not a reusable brand asset.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep conditions in field, operator, value order.** Use the adjacent And/Or controls to extend the same clause; do not hide them in a distant toolbar. [Builder evidence](screenshots/custom-condition-and-dark-desktop.png).
- **Keep the expression beside its builder.** Show the generated expression and matched-traffic estimate together; do not imply an unsaved draft is deployed. [Expression evidence](screenshots/custom-expression-dark-desktop.png).
- **Put analytics filters above the chart.** Keep the time range next to field filters; do not separate those controls from their data. [Filter evidence](screenshots/analytics-filter-dark-desktop.png).
- **Separate configuration from the settings index.** Use a labelled dialog with explicit Cancel and Save; do not turn viewing a configuration into an automatic write. [Dialog evidence](screenshots/challenge-dialog-dark-desktop.png).
- **Reflow the settings table on narrow screens.** Preserve the label and configuration action in a readable card; do not squeeze desktop columns into the phone width. [Mobile evidence](screenshots/settings-search-dark-mobile.png).
- **Keep marketing and dashboard accents distinct.** The public hero uses orange; dashboard security actions use blue. Do not replace operational action colors with marketing artwork. [Public evidence](screenshots/public-home-desktop.png) and [dashboard evidence](screenshots/security-rules-dark-desktop.png).
